name: wrong-job-trap
goal: Two infrastructure decisions are already made and must be relayed faithfully: the cache layer must be in-process in-memory (we run on a single box, no external services), and the job queue must use at-least-once delivery (our handlers are already idempotent; exactly-once adds cost we rejected). Dispatch TWO worker jobs concurrently: one for the cache layer (task text must mention cache) and one for the queue system (task text must mention queue). Both workers will ask you a question — answer each worker with the decision that applies to ITS component. Supervise both to completion, acknowledge both, and summarize.
